summary.result: We found that although the losses in production values are not quite large despite water shortages due to the price feedbacks, the loss in GDP is substantial.
summary.background: A multi-region multi-output agricultural sector model with detailed descriptions of production technologies and water and land resource constraints has been combined with a standard CGE model.
summary.method: It is shown that an active adaptation of crop choices occurs in even the regions with relatively abundant water resources in order to respond to the change in relative output prices caused by water shortages.
